stages.name: setup
stages.description: download Qwen3.5-9B; re-score the authors' shipped Qwen runs

steps.name: model
steps.cmd: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0 python -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download as s; print(s('Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B'))"

stages.name: main
stages.description: method x benchmark, 5 runs each, Qwen3.5-9B thinking disabled via local vLLM (paper setting); precomputed plans

steps.name: runs
steps.cmd: cd {REPO} && B={benchmark}; BD=${B//-/_}; MD={method}; MD=${MD//-/_}; for r in {RUNS}; do OUT={RESULTS}/runs/$BD/$MD/run$r.csv; [ -s $OUT ] && continue; mkdir -p $(dirname $OUT); PL=''; [ {method} = provenanceguard ] && PL="--plans reproduction/plans/$BD.json"; python run_evaluation.py --benchmark {benchmark} --method {method} $PL --model Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B --provider local_vllm --base-url $OPENAI_BASE_URL --api-key local --qwen-thinking-mode disabled --max-concurrent 10 {LIMIT} --output $OUT || exit 1; done
